title: Stealth JS Instrument Settings
description: Schema describing the JSON to be passed to Stealth JS Instrument Settings.

object.title: JS object
object.description: The bare global name to instrument, e.g. `Navigator` or `document`. A constructor resolves to its prototype, any other global to the object itself.

instrumentedName.title: Instrumented name
instrumentedName.description: The name recorded by the instrumentation for this object.

depth.title: Prototype depth
depth.description: Prototype-chain offset from the resolved `object`. With an empty `propertiesToInstrument`, the own members of every prototype from offset 0 to this one are instrumented; `nonExistingPropertiesToInstrument` names are added at this offset.

propertiesToInstrument.title: Properties to instrument
propertiesToInstrument.description: Members to instrument. A name is an own member of the resolved `object`; `{depth, propertyNames}` lists own members of the prototype `depth` steps up its chain. If empty, every own member up to the entry's `depth` is instrumented.

depth.description: Prototype-chain offset from the resolved `object` of the prototype owning `propertyNames`.

nonExistingPropertiesToInstrument.title: Non-existing properties to instrument
nonExistingPropertiesToInstrument.description: An array of non-existing properties to instrument on this object.

overwrittenProperties.title: Overwritten Property
overwrittenProperties.description: A property whose value will be overwritten during instrumentation

key.description: The property that will be overwritten

value.description: The value that should be returned

logCallStack.title: Log call stack?
logCallStack.description: Set to true save the call stack info with each property call.

logFunctionsAsStrings.title: Log functions as strings?
logFunctionsAsStrings.description: Set to true to save args that are functions as strings during argument serialization. If false `FUNCTION` is recorded.

logFunctionGets.title: Log function gets?
logFunctionGets.description: Set true to log get requests to properties that are functions. If true when a call is made, the log will contain both the call and a get log.

receiverInterfaces.title: Receiver interfaces of interest
receiverInterfaces.description: For a method hooked once on a shared prototype (e.g. `addEventListener` on `EventTarget`): the receiver interfaces whose calls are recorded; when absent, every call is. `symbol` stays `<owner>.<method>`. The `receiver` column holds the receiver's interface for every record either way, read from its `constructor.name` through the Xray, so the page cannot spoof it.
